description: Project-wide FX market session and hard no-trade rules. Local times are converted with IANA time zones, so DST is handled by the runtime time-zone database.

hard_no_trade_windows.label: Asia pre-open low-liquidity / New York rollover window
hard_no_trade_windows.rationale: Do not trade the thin-liquidity period before Asian liquidity forms. The rule is anchored to New York local time so the UTC exclusion shifts automatically across US daylight-saving time. User trading experience and public tick profiles both show structurally poor spreads/transaction quality around this window. Any apparent edge inside this window must not be accepted for research or live deployment.
